tagline.zh: UI 弹簧的物理内核:m·ẍ+c·ẋ+k·(x−target)=0 用半隐式欧拉离散——先更新速度、再用新速度推进位置;ζ=c/2√(km) 一行锁死手感,dt 决定能量守恒还是爆炸。
tagline.en: The physics core of UI springs: m·ẍ+c·ẋ+k·(x−target)=0 discretized with semi-implicit Euler — update velocity first, then push position with the NEW velocity; ζ=c/2√(km) pins the feel in one line, dt decides energy conservation vs explosion.

origin.zh: 阻尼谐振子是二阶系统控制论标准模型;半隐式欧拉(Euler–Cromer/辛欧拉)迭代式逐字核对自 Wikipedia《Semi-implicit Euler method》——『v_{n+1}=v_n+g(t_n,x_n)Δt; x_{n+1}=x_n+f(t_n,v_{n+1})Δt』;工业对照为 Motion(原 Framer Motion)物理弹簧:默认 k=100、c=10、m=1,bounce→ζ 映射源码注释『0 为临界阻尼』(自 npm motion-dom@14.14.0 包内 spring.mjs 实读,调研 14§3)。
origin.en: The damped harmonic oscillator is a standard second-order control-theory model; the semi-implicit (Euler–Cromer/symplectic) iteration is quoted verbatim from Wikipedia's 'Semi-implicit Euler method' — 'v_{n+1}=v_n+g(t_n,x_n)Δt; x_{n+1}=x_n+f(t_n,v_{n+1})Δt'; the industrial counterpart is Motion's (ex-Framer Motion) physical spring: defaults k=100, c=10, m=1, and the bounce→ζ mapping documented as '0 = critically damped' (read from motion-dom@14.14.0's spring.mjs, research 14 §3).

effect.zh: 弹簧刚度 k(N/m)。默认 100 = Motion 物理弹簧出厂值;决定固有角频率 ω₀=√(k/m)——k 越大节奏越急促,过冲比例(只由 ζ 决定)不变。
effect.en: Spring stiffness k (N/m). Default 100 = Motion's factory spring; sets the natural frequency ω₀=√(k/m) — larger k quickens the rhythm while overshoot ratio (governed only by ζ) stays put.

effect.zh: 阻尼系数 c(N·s/m)。默认 10 与 k=100、m=1 组成 Motion 出厂手感:ζ=0.5、过冲 16.3%;调到 20 即临界阻尼(ζ=1,最快无过冲)。
effect.en: Damping coefficient c (N·s/m). Default 10 with k=100, m=1 is Motion's factory feel: ζ=0.5, overshoot 16.3%; raise to 20 for critical damping (ζ=1, fastest with no overshoot).

effect.zh: 质量 m(kg)。默认 1;放大 m 同时压低 ω₀ 并压低 ζ(临界阻尼 c_crit=2√(km) 抬高)——「重元素反应慢且更容易晃」的数学来源。
effect.en: Mass m (kg). Default 1; growing m lowers both ω₀ and ζ (while critical damping c_crit=2√(km) rises) — the math behind 'heavy elements feel slower and wobblier'.

effect.zh: 积分步长(毫秒)。默认 4ms ≈ 1/240s(调研核验精度);dt≤1/120 时辛积分器能量不漂移;dt 过大时半隐式会先变硬后发散,而显式欧拉在更小的 dt 就爆炸——demo 把两条曲线叠出来对照。
effect.en: Integration step (milliseconds). Default 4ms ≈ 1/240s (the research's verified precision); at dt≤1/120 the symplectic integrator keeps energy drift-free; large dt first stiffens then diverges the semi-implicit curve, while explicit Euler explodes at even smaller dt — the demo overlays both curves.

note.zh: 纯 JS 数值计算,无平台差异;浏览器动画一般按 rAF 帧节拍取 dt(60Hz≈16.7ms),本条公式的 dt 指物理步长——帧率波动时按真实 Δt 逐步积分即可,必要时对单步 dt 设上限防大帧间隔爆炸。
note.en: Pure JS numerics, no platform variance; browser animations typically take dt from the rAF frame cadence (60Hz ≈ 16.7ms) — here dt means the physics step: integrate with the real Δt per frame, and cap a single dt to guard against long-frame blowups.

fallback.zh: 数值发散(显式欧拉、dt 过大)时钳制单步 dt(如 ≤1/120s)并视作能量泄漏处理;不支持高精度定时器的环境按帧长积分即可——弹簧积分对精度不敏感,ζ 定形状、dt 只定保真度。
fallback.en: On numerical divergence (explicit Euler, oversized dt), clamp the per-step dt (e.g. ≤1/120s) and treat it as energy leakage; on environments without high-resolution timers, integrate per frame length — the integrator is precision-tolerant: ζ sets the shape, dt only the fidelity.

use.zh: 自研弹簧动画引擎:手写积分器而非依赖库,先算 ζ 再定参数
use.en: In-house spring engines: hand-write the integrator instead of pulling a library; compute ζ before picking parameters

use.zh: 弹簧→linear() 采样编译的采样端:物理步长积分后输出关键帧(linear-easing 条目的上游)
use.en: The sampling side of spring→linear() compilation: integrate at the physics step, emit keyframes (upstream of the linear-easing entry)

use.zh: 设计系统动效 token 定标:给定目标过冲/整定时间反解 ζ 与 k
use.en: Calibrating motion tokens for a design system: solve ζ and k back from target overshoot/settling time

use.zh: 评审弹簧手感:用 OS=e^(−πζ/√(1−ζ²)) 与 t_s≈4/(ζω₀) 把「感觉」换算成数字
use.en: Reviewing spring feel: convert 'vibes' into numbers with OS=e^(−πζ/√(1−ζ²)) and t_s≈4/(ζω₀)

avoid.zh: 显式欧拉做生产积分——同一参数同一 dt 下比半隐式更早发散、能量持续注入
avoid.en: Explicit Euler in production — it diverges earlier and pumps energy where semi-implicit conserves

avoid.zh: 把帧间隔原样当 dt 而不设上限——掉帧到 200ms 的一帧会把弹簧炸飞
avoid.en: Using raw frame gaps as dt without a cap — one 200ms hiccup flings the spring off screen

avoid.zh: 只调 k 不看 ζ——k 只改节奏不改过冲比例,「弹多少」永远由 ζ 说了算
avoid.en: Tuning k while ignoring ζ — k changes only the tempo; how far it overshoots is ζ's verdict alone

avoid.zh: 超大 m 配小 c 的「仪式感」参数——ω₀ 掉到个位数,整定时间以秒计,交互像陷进泥里
avoid.en: Ceremonial giant-m + tiny-c combos — ω₀ drops to single digits and settling takes seconds, interactions sink into mud

a11y.zh: 弹簧参数最终都落回 CSS transform 动画,必须全局尊重 prefers-reduced-motion(跳过或直落终态);过冲不是装饰——对前庭障碍用户大幅度过冲是真实的生理不适,ζ≥0.8 是无障碍弹簧的稳妥档;数值曲线 demo 不承载唯一信息,读数以文本同步输出。
a11y.en: Spring parameters ultimately drive CSS transform animation and must honor prefers-reduced-motion globally (skip or jump to the end state); overshoot is not decoration — large overshoot causes genuine vestibular discomfort, making ζ≥0.8 the safe accessibility tier; the plotted curve carries no sole information, readings are duplicated as text.

goal.zh: 手写一个零依赖弹簧积分器:半隐式欧拉迭代式 + ζ/过冲/整定时间解析读数,参数 k/c/m/dt 可调,能复现 Motion 默认手感(ζ=0.5、过冲≈16.3%)。
goal.en: Hand-write a zero-dependency spring integrator: the semi-implicit iteration plus analytic ζ/overshoot/settling readouts, with k/c/m/dt adjustable, reproducing Motion's default feel (ζ=0.5, overshoot≈16.3%).

acceptance.zh: 迭代顺序必须是先速度后位置:v_{n+1}=v_n+(−k(x_n−target)−c·v_n)/m×dt;x_{n+1}=x_n+v_{n+1}×dt
acceptance.en: Velocity first, position second: v_{n+1}=v_n+(−k(x_n−target)−c·v_n)/m×dt; x_{n+1}=x_n+v_{n+1}×dt
Full analytic readouts: ω₀=√(k/m), c_crit=2√(km), ζ=c/(2√(km)), OS=e^(−πζ/√(1−ζ²)), t_s≈4/(ζω₀)

acceptance.zh: Motion 默认参数 (100,10,1) 必须得 ζ=0.5、OS≈16.3%、c_crit=20
acceptance.en: Motion's defaults (100,10,1) must yield ζ=0.5, OS≈16.3%, c_crit=20

acceptance.zh: dt 默认 ≤1/120s;单步 dt 有上限保护,显式欧拉只作对照不进生产
acceptance.en: Default dt ≤1/120s; per-step dt is capped; explicit Euler is for comparison only, never production

acceptance.zh: 仿真与解析互相验证:仿真过冲与 OS 差 <1%(dt=1/240 时约 0.3%)
acceptance.en: Simulation cross-checks analytics: sim overshoot within <1% of OS (≈0.3% at dt=1/240)
